tailoring.headline: Senior SAP CX Consultant | SAP Commerce Cloud, Integrations & Techno-Functional Delivery
tailoring.summary: SAP Certified Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Developer and Techno-Functional Consultant with 5+ years of experience delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Extensive background translating business requirements into technical architectures across SAP Commerce Cloud (2105/2211), OCC REST APIs, and integrations with SAP ERP, PIM, and MDM systems. Experienced in end-to-end agile delivery, stakeholder management, solution design, and AI-assisted analysis.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior SAP CX Consultant
cover_en.hook: With over 5 years of hands-on experience building and consulting on enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud platforms for global leaders like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am excited to apply for the Senior SAP CX Consultant position at IgniteSAP. I specialize in bridging business needs with robust technical architecture across complex SAP landscapes.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting & Analysis
bullets.text: Worked in a techno-functional role with business stakeholders, gathering requirements, writing user stories and functional specifications, and mapping processes to scalable SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Enterprise SAP CX Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and implemented end-to-end e-commerce solutions on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211), covering B2B/B2C commerce, catalog management, OMS, and headless storefronts.

bullets.label: Seamless Data & System Integrations
bullets.text: Engineered and resolved integration bottlenecks across SAP ERP, MDM, and Profisee PIM platforms using DataHub, Hotfolders, and custom OCC REST Web Services.

bullets.label: Delivery Leadership & Production Support
bullets.text: Executed CCv2 release deployments, led database query refactoring to optimize performance, and supported user acceptance testing (UAT) and production troubleshooting.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, serving my notice period until 15 December 2026, and available to start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my experience can benefit your team.

tailoring.why_company: IgniteSAP stands out as a dedicated leader in connecting high-caliber SAP specialists with transformative enterprise initiatives. Joining IgniteSAP as a Senior SAP CX Consultant allows me to leverage my 5+ years of hands-on SAP Commerce Cloud and techno-functional integration experience across diverse, high-impact client environments in Germany.
tailoring.motivation_short: As an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of experience at Shell and Rockwell Automation, I offer a strong blend of techno-functional consulting, SAP ERP/PIM integration, and hands-on CCv2 delivery to drive client success as a Senior SAP CX Consultant.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I noticed the Senior SAP CX Consultant opportunity at IgniteSAP. With 5+ years in SAP Commerce Cloud (Shell, Rockwell Automation) and techno-functional integration expertise, I would welcome the chance to connect regarding how I can contribute to your team in Germany.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Senior SAP CX Consultant – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior SAP CX Consultant position at IgniteSAP.

With over 5 years of professional experience delivering enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Shell and Rockwell Automation, I bring techno-functional consulting expertise, strong integration capabilities, and SAP certification. I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit and available from 16 December 2026.

I look forward to discussing how my background aligns with your requirements.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
